name: Nathan Adams
milestone_by_age_26: Hired by Mojang Studios on February 28, 2012 (age 20) as a Minecraft developer focused on the mod API, after co-creating the widely used Bukkit plugin platform and working at Curse.
early_history_summary: Born July 23, 1991 in the UK (Shrewsbury area). Learned programming around age 10 building MSN bots. After secondary school he was rejected from college, worked at a small web firm, then co-built Bukkit, joined Curse, and was hired by Mojang at 20 to work on Minecraft's modding API and later core Java Edition and launcher features.
family_context_summary: Not documented in reviewed sources beyond British origin in Shrewsbury, UK.
primary_early_advantage_tags: Bukkit, Minecraft mod community, peer cofounders, open source, early programming, college rejection constraint
evidence_summary: Nathan 'Dinnerbone' Adams (b. 1991) co-led Bukkit, the dominant Minecraft server plugin platform, then was hired by Mojang on 28 Feb 2012 at age 20 to build the official mod API—verified by Minecraft Wiki, his Reddit AMA, and contemporaneous Bukkit announcements. He programmed from age ~10, was rejected from college, and rose through community open-source work and Curse employment rather than elite institutions. Later he remained a long-time Mojang Minecraft engineer (with health-related leaves), obtained Swedish citizenship in 2019, and continued Java Edition/launcher work into the mid-2020s.
starting_point: Born 1991 in Shrewsbury, UK; self-taught programmer from about age 10 with no elite university pipeline after college rejection.
current_position: Software engineer at Mojang Studios working on Minecraft Java Edition and related tooling; Swedish and British citizen; living as of 2025–2026 research.

trajectory.event: Began learning programming by building MSN chat bots.
Co-created and developed Bukkit, which became the primary plugin platform for Minecraft multiplayer servers.
Hired by Mojang on February 28, 2012 to develop Minecraft's mod API after prior Curse employment.
Announced a temporary break from Minecraft PC development while remaining at Mojang on other projects.
Rejoined the Minecraft PC team at Mojang after time on other internal work.
Became a Swedish citizen after relocating for Mojang work.
Publicly stated multi-year health leave that limited ability to work.
Announced return to active Minecraft development after health recovery progress.
